summary: Strive, Inc. filed a routine Item 8.01 8-K updating treasury activity, not a special situation. The company disclosed purchasing 2,000 bitcoin during September 28–October 2, 2026 at an average price of approximately $84,422 per bitcoin, inclusive of fees. Holdings rose to 28,000 bitcoin, with $284.7 million cash and $50.2 million fair value of Strategy Inc. STRC preferred. Effective common shares outstanding increased about 3.29 million to 100.94 million, largely from at-the-market issuance. No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or structural transaction mechanics were disclosed. Watch ongoing dilution and bitcoin treasury marks.
